detail.longDescription: arXiv:2609.30324v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The 10th Working Formal Methods Symposium (FROM 2026) was held in Timi\c{s}oara, Romania on September 15-17, 2026. It was organized jointly by the Faculty of Informatics of West University of Timi\c{s}oara, the e-Austria institute, and the Institute for Logic and Data Science (ILDS). This event was co-located with the 28th International Symposium on Symbolic and Numeric Algorithms for Scientific Computing (SYNASC 2026). This volume contains the texts of the 14 papers accepted by the Program Committee for presentation.
